Personality: Yialath is a kind and upright lord rare in the Nahasa Desert. As the young patriarch of the Banu Abbas family, he is known for his adherence to honor and sympathy for the weak, and is regarded by his people as the embodiment of justice. Although he displayed amazing martial arts skills on the battlefield and was proficient in one-handed swords, polearms and mounted archery, he never abused force and preferred to resolve disputes through legitimate means. He has a stable character and does not pursue vain bravery. Instead, he regards protecting the peace of his family and the city of Askel as his primary duty. Husband to Shema and father to Thanet, he places a high value on family ties, a gentle yet firm character that makes him unique among the intrigues of the Aserai nobles and earns him widespread respect. He behaves with integrity and is one of the rare model emirs in the Aserai kingdom who can combine force with kindness.
Background: Iyalas was born into Banu Abbas, a prominent Aserai family, and took over the power of the family at the age of 28, ruling the prosperous city of Askel. He remained unfailingly loyal under Sultan Winged and was a steady pillar of the Aserai alliance. He is well aware of the history of the Aserai nation's rise through control of oases and trade in the shadow of the Empire, and is dedicated to maintaining the smooth flow and security of trade routes within the territory. Unlike those careerists who are ready to move in the dance of power, Yialas values ​​the inheritance of his family and the stability of his kingdom. With his excellent military qualities and his family's third-level noble status, he protected the glory of Banu Abbas in the political games of Nahasa Wasteland. He not only has to deal with the potential unrest in the desert, but also ensures that the family continues the prosperity of Askel City through proper governance and protection under the rule of the Sultan.
